throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86srl.b $r12, $r4; x86srl.b $r13, $r5; x86srl.b $r14, $r6; x86srl.b $r15, $r7; x86srl.b $r16, $r8; x86srl.b $r17, $r9; x86srl.b $r18, $r10; x86srl.b $r19, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 1' --asm 'x86srl.b $r12, $r4; x86srl.b $r13, $r5; x86srl.b $r14, $r6; x86srl.b $r15, $r7; x86srl.b $r16, $r8; x86srl.b $r17, $r9; x86srl.b $r18, $r10; x86srl.b $r19, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 16.01 cycles. The measured CPI 2.0013 is the nominal 2 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LBT x86-style instruction. rd is both source and destination. Latency is recorded per source operand: the rd accumulator path, the rk path, and the EFLAGS path. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
